[b][h2]Dear Friends,
[/h2][/b]Happy Valentine's Day! If you don't have a partner yet, why not give our game a try? If you do have a partner, you can play our game together!
Since the release of our game, we have been grateful for your support. For any shortcomings in our work, please be understanding.
Since its launch, our game has received a lot of attention from players in Chinese-speaking regions, and you have given us so much support!

Indeed, in our community and through media, we have noticed that players from Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and Singapore who speak Traditional Chinese have shown a lot of interest in our game.
We have decided to adjust the prices for players in the following regions:

[u][b]Hong Kong Dollar[/b][/u]

[u][b]New Taiwan Dollar[/b][/u]

The "108 Silly Ways to Die" Development Team

notes.title: Apology Letter Before Release! There are only 100 ways to die in the game :(
notes.content:
Dear fellow gamers,

Hello everyone! We are the team behind the game "108 Silly Ways to Die," and we feel it is necessary to write this apology letter to you all before the game's release.

After completing the game and making a series of adjustments, the final number of ways to die in the game is only 100, which does not meet the initial target of "108" as stated in the game's title. For this, we sincerely apologize to all of you!

We have decided that, in addition to the original 10% discount during the initial launch, we will offer an additional 1% discount for each missing way to die. [u][b]This means that during the initial launch phase, we will provide a total discount of -18%![/b][/u]

Let us explain further about the number of ways to die and the game's title!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257313/5b6378ed4e67305bc39753b4e66837d01eefdddf.png[/img]

In our initial script, we did indeed include 108 ways to die, and we launched the entire project's filming and pre-release promotion with the title "108 Silly Ways to Die." However, during the game development and re-evaluation of all the segments, we found that some of the ways to die were repetitive or unreasonable. After making necessary deletions and revisions, we were left with the current 100 ways to die. For various reasons, we realized that changing the game's title and promotional materials at this stage would cause even greater confusion for both the marketing and the players.

But we should face this issue proactively! If we have the opportunity in the future, we will release a free DLC to supplement the game and reach the "108" ways to die as mentioned in the title. However, we do not want our promises to become empty checks. Therefore, we have decided that [b][u]until this DLC is released, the regular price of the game will always be discounted by -8%![/u][/b] After the initial launch period, we will also offer a bundle with an -8% discount!

Once again, we thank you all for your support and hope to continue bringing you more interesting interactive cinematic games in the future!

Best regards,
The "108 Silly Ways to Die" Team

notes.title: Countdown to the release of 108 Silly Ways to Die in just 3 days!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257313/e4d09b70f347a9f4ae501b446631637bfcb79901.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone! We are the development team behind 108 Silly Ways to Die!
We're super excited to announce that our game will be officially released in just 3 days!!!
This is a horror-themed interactive film game. Players find themselves involved in a bizarre incident, where they are taken to a mysterious ruin by three beautiful ladies for an adventure.

In this ruin, it seems that there exist some surreal creatures...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257313/015325b887d9e40edf36fd627fad3c6c12d97f5b.png[/img]
According to the definition of humans, these creatures are called "zombies."

In the game, players will encounter a variety of zombies, some of which even have stories behind them that are unknown to most people.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257313/7d868417d8c9b5c2801a99817b48748d6e5f1c44.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257313/2f7a9b3d1929ece372bd33fd6d30136fdb39e3f9.jpg[/img]

【Warning】 The game does contain some scenes where zombies suddenly lunge at the camera. Players with sensitive hearts should consider carefully before playing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257313/4d0a63cb815b1d71d19d9d89f53b74b1fb7761eb.jpg[/img]


In terms of setting, we have faithfully recreated the facilities that you would expect to find in an abandoned medical college. We've done our best to bring the world envisioned in the script to life. Additionally, we've used a lot of graffiti and lighting to enhance the mysterious atmosphere of this adventure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257313/61ecd44e1e11a0fd3ddf386c23aca2111cc9251d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257313/60709f8e02b172effa7af74fcf0d4ac7a1a6c3c7.jpg[/img]
Some eerie dolls might also add to the spooky atmosphere!

Add the game to your wishlist! We look forward to starting this adventure with you on February 12th!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3159900

Additionally, don't worry about the death scenes in our game being too terrifying. 
All the death animations are depicted using stick figures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257313/00621d26251aef86127ccc765a5d837caafe1047.jpg[/img]
We hope it will bring everyone a good dose of fun!
